comment: Debug-mode Barbarian (packorder puts potions before scrolls, menustyle:partial) wears wished rings of levitation and fire resistance, lights a wished potion of oil and uses the D menu to drop it together with five wished scrolls. The oil falls from levitation height, shatters and explodes; destroy_items() for the blast clears the bypass bits menu_drop() set on the inventory, so each remaining selected scroll fails the bypass check at do.c:1094-1095 and stays in the pack. Independent seed, date and character.
